variant.author: AlexCSDev
variant.changelog: - Map links from the Dravanian Hinterlands are now served by the neighbouring zones aetherytes.
variant.description:
Set your game window to arbitrary size not limited by your display resolution. Mostly useful for taking high-resolution screenshots without going fullscreen and using DSR/FSR.
Requires borderless or windowed mode.
variant.name: XIVWindowResizer
variant.punchline: Game window resizing plugin. Ever wanted to take 8K screenshots on 144p screen? Now you can.
